items.title: Is it acceptable to nest parentheses?
items.x_text:
❓ Is it acceptable to nest parentheses?

✅ Yes, nesting parentheses is acceptable but should be used carefully.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sEaKPv_vvb0
#COSMOS #punctuation

discovery.short_answer: Yes, nesting parentheses is acceptable but should be used carefully.
discovery.full_answer: Nesting parentheses is allowed, but it is important to use them with caution. Long or complex nested parentheses can confuse readers, making it difficult to track where the parenthetical sections begin and end. In formal writing such as serious papers and letters, it is best to avoid nested parentheses altogether and instead rephrase the text to eliminate the need for them. In informal contexts like emails, blog posts, or online forums, short nested parentheses (just a few words) may be more acceptable. The key is to ensure clarity so the reader does not lose track of the structure. For example, long nested parentheses can be broken into separate sentences or paragraphs to improve readability and avoid confusion.
discovery.grok_perspective: Nesting parentheses risks confusing readers if layers accumulate, so writers often prefer alternatives like dashes or rephrasing for better flow.

items.title: Is it possible to add a horizontal line to apple notes on a mac?
items.x_text:
❓ Is it possible to add a horizontal line to apple notes on a mac?

✅ No native horizontal line feature; use an image workaround instead.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=db9-UxidTqw
#COSMOS #macos

discovery.short_answer: No native horizontal line feature; use an image workaround instead.
discovery.full_answer: Apple Notes on Mac does not have a built-in option to insert a horizontal line. A common workaround is to create a thin, wide image (e.g., 2400x6 pixels) filled with a solid color and save it as a .jpg or .png file. You can then copy and paste this image into your note where you want the horizontal line. This image will adjust its width with the Notes window, providing a visual horizontal separator. To streamline this process, you can use tools like TextExpander or create an Automator service with AppleScript to insert the image via a keyboard shortcut. This method is not perfect but is currently the best available solution to simulate a horizontal line in Apple Notes on Mac.
discovery.grok_perspective: Software interfaces and features can shift across updates, making it prudent to test directly in the current macOS version rather than relying on prior reports.

The deleted film scene, although never officially released, depicts Michael personally shooting Fabrizio. Therefore, Michael did get revenge against those who killed his wife, specifically Fabrizio.

After discovering an old, large cast iron cauldron missing from their property, the family used the idea of a 'missing cauldron' as a playful book title. This was not an official Harry Potter book title but rather a humorous and fitting choice among many suggested titles for their art project. discovery.short_answer: Yes, flight attendants can legally block you from assisting in another class.
discovery.full_answer: Flight crews have significant authority to control passenger movement and enforce seating rules on an aircraft. Passengers are legally required to follow crew instructions, even if those instructions seem unreasonable. To avoid such issues, it is advisable to contact the airline's special assistance department before travel, request necessary accommodations in writing, and only book the flight once the airline confirms the arrangements. This proactive approach helps ensure you can assist your disabled family member as needed without conflict during the flight.

items.title: Is glycolysis the beginning part of fermentation, or does fermentation follow glycolysis?
items.x_text:
❓ Is glycolysis the beginning part of fermentation, or does fermentation follow glycolysis?

✅ Fermentation follows glycolysis; glycolysis is part of fermentation.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YbdkbCU20_M
#COSMOS #fermentation

discovery.short_answer: Fermentation follows glycolysis; glycolysis is part of fermentation.
discovery.full_answer: Fermentation is a metabolic process that converts sugars into products like alcohol or lactic acid, often occurring without oxygen. Glycolysis is the initial stage where glucose is broken down into pyruvate, producing ATP and NADH. In many definitions, fermentation includes glycolysis as the first step, followed by the conversion of pyruvate into fermentation products such as ethanol or lactate. However, some sources distinguish fermentation as only the steps after glycolysis, focusing on the conversion of pyruvate. Overall, glycolysis precedes and is considered part of fermentation in the broader biochemical context, but usage can vary depending on the source or emphasis.
discovery.grok_perspective: Definitions of fermentation can vary, with some descriptions treating glycolysis as an integrated initial stage in anaerobic metabolism rather than a strictly separate precursor. This framing depends on the specific pathway and cellular context under discussion.

items.title: How can auto-bridge builders exist in vanilla Java Minecraft?
items.x_text:
❓ How can auto-bridge builders exist in vanilla Java Minecraft?

✅ By using sticky pistons and waterlogged blocks with short pulses.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S2Us_hFULX4
#COSMOS #Curiosity

discovery.short_answer: By using sticky pistons and waterlogged blocks with short pulses.
discovery.full_answer: In vanilla Java Minecraft, auto-bridge builders can exist by exploiting the behavior of sticky pistons and waterlogged blocks. When a sticky piston is powered with a very short redstone pulse (one tick), it pushes a waterlogged block forward but does not pull it back, allowing the block to retain its waterlogged state. This means a single water source block can be moved. By pushing two waterlogged blocks, the water flows to create a new infinite water source. Players can then use an armor stand with frost walker boots to freeze this water into temporary ice, which remains solid in areas without skylight, such as The End, preventing it from melting. This mechanism enables the creation of auto-bridge builders in vanilla Java Minecraft without mods.
discovery.grok_perspective: Vanilla Java Minecraft redstone systems can produce automated structures, but their behavior depends on version-specific mechanics that may shift or break unexpectedly. Players should test any such setup directly rather than assuming permanence.
